title: [narrowed from compose-lessons-are-loaded-but-never-credited-so-their-relevance-decays-with-use] feature-compose.ts load
description:
[narrowed from compose-lessons-are-loaded-but-never-credited-so-their-relevance-decays-with-use] feature-compose.ts loads compose_lesson concepts into the drafter prompt and never records whether they helped, so the corpus cannot be graded: 17 compose_lesson concepts are loaded, 0 have ever been credited. Concept relevance is (times_succeeded + 1) / (times_loaded + 2), so an uncredited lesson's relevance decays monotonically with every use.

WHY FIVE ATTEMPTS FAILED, AND WHAT TO DO DIFFERENTLY. Two failure modes are recorded on this gap: anchor_not_found, and TS2322 from changing composeLessonsBlock to return {text, conceptIds} while its declared type stayed Promise<string>. Do NOT change any function signature, and do NOT try to replace the whole (async () => { ... })(); block in one operation — that needs a ~25-line verbatim anchor and this file's drafter does not reproduce long anchors reliably. Use a module-scoped handoff instead. Three edits, each anchored on a single short line.

EDIT 1 - capture the ids where the lessons are already fetched correctly. composeLessonsBlock already performs the CORRECT search (right URL, right auth header, right nesting, right parse); it simply drops the ids by mapping to c.content. Anchor on this exact line:

    const found = (json.content ?? []).map((c) => c.content).filter((s): s is string => typeof s === "string" && s.length > 0);

and follow it with a line that records the ids into a module-scoped array, reading id off the same items:

    lastPrimedLessonIds = (json.content ?? []).map((c) => c.id).filter((s): s is string => typeof s === "string" && s.length > 0);

EDIT 2 - declare that array at module scope, immediately above the composeLessonsBlock declaration. Anchor on this exact line:

    async function composeLessonsBlock(specText?: string, failureClasses: string[] = []): Promise<string> {

and prepend a declaration line before it:

    let lastPrimedLessonIds: string[] = [];

EDIT 3 - credit them where the outcome is already known. appendComposeLesson receives cls and runs exactly when a failure class has been decided. Anchor on the FIRST line of the existing inert block:

          const response = await fetch(`${CONCEPT_DB_ENDPOINT}/impulses/resolve`, {

That block is broken in five separate ways and must not be repaired in place: it posts to the wrong path (missing the /v2 prefix), sends the header X-Api-Key where the accepted form is Authorization: ApiKey, sends the pointer fields flat instead of nested under `pointer`, types the response as a bare array when it is an object with a content array, and posts to /usage/{id}/fail where the working endpoint is /concepts/{id}/usage with a body. Delegate instead of re-implementing.

PROVEN CONTRACT - verified by an executed call on 2026-09-09 06:09, which moved times_failed from 0 to 1 and returned {"credited":1,"errors":0}:

    resolveCreditPrimedConcepts({ type: "credit_primed_concepts", conceptIds: lastPrimedLessonIds, outcome: "failure" })

called IN-PROCESS. feature-compose.ts already imports sibling resolvers with a .js suffix, so add:

    import { resolveCreditPrimedConcepts } from "./credit-primed-concepts.js";

DO NOT call credit_primed_concepts without conceptIds: its legacy fallback queries /concepts/search with no source_type filter and would credit arbitrary concepts. Guard the call so it is skipped when lastPrimedLessonIds is empty.

TYPE CHECK. lastPrimedLessonIds is string[] at module scope; conceptIds expects string[]; nothing else changes type. The response items carry id (verified live: {"id":"concept_mdEvyKBG2IIs", "times_loaded":431, "times_succeeded":0, ...}), so `.map((c) => c.id)` requires that ConceptLike-shaped inline type to include an optional id field - widen it in place if the compiler objects, rather than changing any function signature.

HOW TO KNOW IT WORKED. Not by reading the diff. feature_compose fails a large fraction of attempts, so a wired credit path must make times_failed START INCREMENTING for source_type='compose_lesson'. A success counter that stays at 0 is ambiguous; a FAILURE counter that stays at 0 proves the path still never runs. Query concept-db for source_type='compose_lesson' and compare times_failed before and after a few composes.

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- wrong_location: adversarial refuters agreed 2/2 (conf 1.00, 1.00): The patch addresses the gap with a 'DESTROY-TO-SATISFY' approach. The original block for `appendComposeLesson` (lines 3086-3091) is not actually fixi
- typecheck_dangling_reference: src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts(3086,19): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'resolveCreditPrimedConcepts'.
src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts(3327,61): error TS2339: Property 'id' does not exist on type '
- syntax_break: src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts(3096,20): error TS1005: ';' expected.
src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts(3096,38): error TS1005: ';' expected.
src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts(3096,71): error TS1005: '

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
